verdict.rationale: WorkOS docs briefly reference enrolling users in MFA (workos-docs-11) but the evidence pack contains no specifics on TOTP authenticator apps, backup codes, or step-up enforcement mechanics, nor any independent corroboration of these MFA modalities working in practice.
